metadata.title: Dak Prescott (hand) logs full practice on estimated report Monday

metadata.description: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott (hand) picked up a left-hand injury when his left hand was bent back in the win on Sunday against the visiting Tennessee Titans, but he practiced in full on Monday and should be good for the Thanksgiving Day game on Thursday versus the division-rival Philadelphia Eagles, according to Nick Harris of the Fort Worth Star-Telegram. The 33-year-old Prescott and the red-hot Cowboys offense will be looking to keep things rolling against the Eagles this week on Turkey Day. Prescott has thrown for 300-plus yards in three straight games against the Indianapolis Colts, San Francisco 49ers, and Titans, and he will be looking to make it four straight against Philly on a short week. He has been on a heater in the last three games, going 79-for-118 passing with 1,003 yards, 11 touchdowns, and only one interception. In addition to his four passing touchdowns on Sunday against Tennessee, Prescott added his first rushing touchdown of the year. Fantasy managers should continue to treat Prescott as a high-end QB1 option against the Eagles in Week 12. In the first meeting with Philly in a 38-21 win on Oct. 26, Prescott went 15-for-27 passing for 212 yards and three touchdown passes. He has already cleared 3,000 yards passing this season and has 25 passing touchdowns and only six interceptions.
metadata.title: Dak Prescott a Full Participant With Hand Injury

metadata.analysis: Prescott added a fifth touchdown on the day on the ground. He tossed touchdowns to CeeDee Lamb, George Pickens, Javonte Williams and Brevyn Spann-Ford through the air. He'll face the Eagles next on Thanksgiving.
metadata.description: Dak Prescott completed 28-of-33 passes for 325 yards and four touchdowns in the Cowboys 51-30 win over the Titans.
metadata.title: Dak Prescott totals five touchdowns Sunday

metadata.analysis: As the final score and Prescott's numbers indicate, the prolific passer was clicking on all cylinders right out of the gate against an overmatched Titans defense. Prescott had already helped stake the Cowboys to a 27-6 lead by halftime with eight- and 10-yard touchdown strikes to CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens, respectively. Prescott struck again through the air in the second half with an 11-yard touchdown pass to Javonte Williams before closing out his touchdown tally with a two-yard toss to Brevyn Spann-Ford with just under five minutes remaining. Prescott added his second rushing touchdown of the campaign on a two-yard run in the latter portion of the third quarter, giving him his second straight five-TD performance. Prescott is up to 3,049 passing yards and a 25:6 TD:INT heading into a Thanksgiving Day home clash with the Eagles in Week 12.
metadata.description: Prescott completed 28 of 33 passes for 325 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions and added four carries for nine yards and another score in the Cowboys' 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.
metadata.title: Dak Prescott - Five total TDs for second straight week

metadata.description: Dallas Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott threw for 325 yards and four touchdowns on 33 attempts in Sunday's 51-30 win over the Tennessee Titans. He attempted 51 passes a week earlier, throwing for 343 yards and five touchdowns in a loss to the San Francisco 49ers. Dallas led 27-9 at halftime against Tennessee, and Prescott added two touchdown passes and a two-yard touchdown scramble after the break. He finished with nine rushing yards and no turnovers, good for 35.9 fantasy points in standard four-point passing touchdown leagues. Prescott said his hand bent back during a hit and that he felt fine. The Titans entered Week 11 allowing a league-worst 266.9 passing yards per game. Prescott has now topped 300 passing yards in three straight games and accounted for multiple touchdowns in five straight. He remains a high-end QB1 in 12-team leagues for the Thanksgiving rematch with the Philadelphia Eagles. CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens combined for 234 receiving yards and two touchdowns on 22 targets Sunday. They also caught all three of Prescott's touchdown passes in the Week 7 win over Philadelphia, when he threw for 212 yards on 27 attempts.
metadata.title: Dak Prescott Takes High-End QB1 Form Into Thanksgiving
